635:t_135:1.en:
$$桂$$
「If you're saying you're not our enemy, then get out of the way already! It's not like we enjoy fighting either!」

635:t_136:0.en:
$n
「Many people risked their lives to protect this Earth! No matter what you are, I won't hand it over to you!」

635:t_136:1.en:
$n
「I'll do it! That's what $c is for!!」

635:t_137:0.en:
$$刹那$$
「Overcoming conflict...! That is my... no, surely the task entrusted to all humanity!」

635:t_137:1.en:
$$刹那$$
「I'll do it! I exist for that purpose... I'm an $$イノベイター$$!」

635:t_138:0.en:
$$スメラギ$$
(The coming dialogue... That is the true mission of $$ソレスタルビーイング$$...)

635:t_138:1.en:
$$スメラギ$$
(Then I'll do it...! I'll stake everything we've done on this battle!)

635:t_139:0.en:
$$カズミ$$
「$$ノリコ$$! That space monster...!」

635:t_139:1.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「I know, Big Sis! They look no different from the ones we've fought before, but their power is in a whole other league!」

635:t_139:2.en:
$$カズミ$$
「Are you saying they're evolved $$宇宙怪獣|lc$$...!?」

635:t_139:3.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Then all we have to do is surpass them!」

635:t_139:5.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Yes! Now is the time for $$ガンバスター$$ to turn into a flame and burn bright!!」

635:t_140:0.en:
$$ノノ$$
「These $$宇宙怪獣$$...! Tougher than any before...!」

635:t_140:1.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「These $$宇宙怪獣$$...! Tougher than any before...!」

635:t_140:2.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「These $$宇宙怪獣$$...! Tougher than any before...!」

635:t_140:3.en:
$$ノノ$$
「But $$ノノ$$ and everyone else won't give up! As long as the mission to protect Earth is in this heart, $$ノノ$$ and the others will absolutely never lose!!」

635:t_140:4.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「But $$ノノ$$ and everyone else won't give up! As long as the mission to protect Earth is in this heart, $$ノノ$$ and the others will absolutely never lose!!」

635:t_140:5.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「But $$ノノ$$ and everyone else won't give up! As long as the mission to protect Earth is in this heart, $$ノノ$$ and the others will absolutely never lose!!」

635:t_141:0.en:
$$ラルク$$
「This overwhelming power...! Can we... can humanity beat this thing!?」

635:t_141:1.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Is this any time to lose heart!? Earth is right behind us!」

635:t_141:2.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Let's go! Destroying $$宇宙怪獣|lc$$ is the duty of the $$フラタニティ$$!!」

635:t_142:0.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Those sisters... to think they convinced themselves that a monster like this was their savior...」

635:t_142:1.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Damn it...! I was a fool to put my faith in creatures like that!」

635:t_143:0.en:
$$チコ$$
「They were a pain to deal with, but those sisters were $$トップレス$$ comrades too!」

635:t_143:1.en:
$$チコ$$
「Let's go! To avenge the sisters and to protect Earth, I'm taking you down right here!」

635:t_144:0.en:
$$シモン$$
「Bring it on! If you're a monster from space, then we're $$超銀河グレンラガン$$!」

635:t_144:1.en:
$$シモン$$
「We won't lose on scale! All that's left is whose fighting spirit wins out!!」

635:t_145:0.en:
$$刹那$$
「Maybe someday we'll be able to understand each other, even with you...!」

635:t_145:1.en:
$$刹那$$
「But for now, I fight to protect the future! That is my... the mission of $$ソレスタルビーイング$$!!」

635:t_146:0.en:
$$シモン$$
「$$ダヤッカ$$, $$リーロン$$, $$ロージェノム$$, $$アーテンボロー$$! $$テツカン$$, $$ガバル$$, $$シベラ$$!」

635:t_146:2.en:
$$リーロン$$
「We're ready whenever you are!」

635:t_146:3.en:
$$ロージェノム$$
「Now is the time for my new battle.」

635:t_146:5.en:
$$シベラ$$
「The enemy is right in front of us!」

635:t_146:7.en:
$$テツカン$$
「And so is our fighting spirit!」

635:t_146:8.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「The reliable guys are back, I see.」

635:t_146:11.en:
$$シモン$$
「Here we go! I'm pouring the infinite power born of our bond into the drill!」

635:t_146:12.en:
$$シモン$$
「This is our...! $$超銀河グレンラガン$$!!」
